files.subtitle: Pick a file to change.
files.empty: No files configured. Add entries under 'files' in config/app.php.

edit.hint: Change the content and save. Saving replaces the whole file.

append.hint: The current content is hidden. Your text is added at the end of the file.

error.invalid_request: The form was incomplete. Reload the page and try again.
error.text_too_long: The text is too long (max. 1 MB).
error.conflict: The file changed since you opened it. Your text is kept below; save again to replace the current file.
error.file_access: The file could not be read or written. Check the path in config/app.php and the file permissions.
